resources.string: Edit tap text, popup regions and map transitions for Japanese kana keys
These maps are used when Free Flick is selected. Editing does not change the input style.
Entire key · fixed position and size
Add a popup, then choose its action and text.
Select a key or popup. Drag a popup to move it; drag a corner to resize.
Cannot place here: overlaps a popup, the key, or a control after a transition.
Dashed areas: only text popups can appear here after a transition.
No free space. Move or resize an existing popup first.
This map is used by the following popups. Change their destinations or remove them before deleting this map.
The starting map cannot be deleted.
Start inside the key. Enter a control to switch maps; release in a text region to enter text.
Saved maps could not be loaded. Showing defaults; the stored data has not been replaced.
Japanese kana keys only. Popup regions are displayed while using this style.
Map created. Its controls conflict with the source popup; adjust them, then select this map as the destination.
%1$s for English and numbers. Japanese kana uses popup regions and release to enter text.
Freely edit text, destinations, and popup regions
Select the nearest popup outside regions
On: select the eligible popup with the shortest distance to its rounded edge. Off: only the actual regions respond. The tap area stays inside the key.
Display and input preview. Start on は to try. The guide above still uses the original key as the input origin.
Replace all maps for key “%1$s” with standard 12-key flick. This affects input only after saving and can be undone.
Standard 12-key map. Add popup regions for text or map transitions.
Outside regions, the nearest eligible popup is selected. Change this in Free Flick settings.
Set two-step popup size, text size, and position
Drag points to reshape the popup. Tap an edge + to add a vertex. Removing a vertex from a triangle makes a circle; adding to a circle makes a triangle.
The dashed line is the placement box. Move vertices within it; move and resize the box in the main editor. Placement boxes cannot overlap. Apply changes the draft; Save updates actual input.
Edges cannot cross or overlap. Adjust the selected vertex.
